payload.note: HARD context trip at the advance boundary: gauge 17.9% of a 1M window (178K tokens) against a 150K hard cap. Parked, did not push through. m1-d2-symbol-identity.title: D2: a nested definition's symbol carries its enclosing METHOD
m1-d2-symbol-identity.imperative: Defect (a). scripts/code_map/extract.py builds a definition's symbol from clsstack[-1] whenever any class is on the stack, so a closure defined inside Class.method is emitted as mod:Class.<closure> and two same-named closures in two methods of one class merge into one symbol with a unioned caller set. Write the reproducer FIRST, naming the four measured collisions from .agent-work/issue-456/reference/d2_collisions.txt individually by string -- not by count -- plus a synthetic fixture for the class-defined-inside-a-function arm, which has zero occurrences on this corpus. Commit the reproducer FAILING. Then make each definition's symbol the enclosing scope's symbol plus its own name, so it equals supplement.py's qualified key, and keep every resolver that spells a class-qualified symbol (self.x, cls.x, the class-body name rule) spelling the same string. Attest c1 with the before/after symbol string for all four named collisions.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the reproducer names the four measured collisions individually and was observed FAILING on the pre-fix extractor, and is committed in that failing state -- manual attest, with the RED command output and exit code and the before/after symbol strings
the four named collisions resolve to four distinct symbols each carrying its enclosing method, the class-in-function arm is covered synthetically, and tests/test_code_map.py is green

check.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR -u PYTHONIOENCODING python -m pytest tests/test_code_map.py -q --color=no

constraints: name the four collisions by string; `all N resolve` is vacuous -- it passes on an empty set
state plainly that the class-in-function arm has no real-corpus instance here
do not weaken or delete any of the six checks g1 shipped

m2-refs-accounting.title: Referenced-by: the count and the list are reconcilable, and the page says what the count means
m2-refs-accounting.imperative: Defect (b). scripts/code_map/render.py refs_line() prints a site total and a module total that both include the page's own module, and a name list that silently omits it; nothing on the page states that the count already excludes the definition, imports, inheritance, writes and docstring mentions. Write the reproducer FIRST -- a page whose own module references it must let a reader reconcile every counted site against the list, and every page carrying an inbound line must state what the count includes and excludes -- and commit it FAILING. Then make the line account for the own-module sites explicitly and add the legend. Update scripts/code_map/checks.py ONLY in its rendered-line grammar (the block that documents itself as the one place that knows how a page spells its inbound references) and strengthen refs_line_self_consistent so the unnamed module must be exactly the one the line accounts for; do not remove any failure mode it already has. Attest c1 with the RED output and exit code.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the reconciliation reproducer and the legend reproducer were observed FAILING before the fix and are committed in that failing state -- manual attest, with the RED command output and exit code

count and list reconcile with no silent omission, every inbound line is followed by a statement of what the count includes and excludes, and the g1 checks (inbound-attribution, refs-line-self-consistent) still pass with every failure mode they had

check.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR -u PYTHONIOENCODING python -m pytest tests/test_code_map.py -q --color=no

constraints: do NOT fix page accounting by counting the rendered tree a second time (tc24 corrects tc18)
do not touch the line base or the page header format
OWN_MODULE_NAMED_MUTATION's anchor line in render.py must survive byte-exact, or g1's falsifier is destroyed

m3-page-identity.title: Page identity: two entity names differing only by case cannot land on one file
m3-page-identity.imperative: Defect (c), ruled in scope. scripts/code_map/render.py writes each entity page as key.split(':',1)[1] + '.md', so scripts.run_skill_eval:Verdict and :verdict resolve to one filename on a case-insensitive filesystem and one page silently overwrites the other. Write the reproducer FIRST over a SYNTHETIC module holding a fresh case-only pair with nothing to do with Verdict -- a fix that only resolves the pair you were shown cannot fail on the next pair -- and commit it FAILING. Then make case-only collisions impossible by construction in the renderer's page naming, deterministically (hashlib, never the builtin hash: PYTHONHASHSEED varies and deterministic-rebuild would catch it). Do NOT rename class Verdict or def verdict in scripts/run_skill_eval.py -- Commander ruling. Delete the strict-xfail marker at tests/test_code_map.py:982; strict forces this. Attest c1 with the RED output and exit code.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: the synthetic case-only pair reproducer was observed FAILING before the fix and is committed in that failing state -- manual attest, with the RED command output and exit code
the synthetic case-only pair renders two distinct pages, the strict-xfail marker is deleted, and `python -m scripts.code_map check` exits 0 on this repository
